free_tier.stated: $0 Free Sandbox: full API access in a rate-limited test environment, a shared phone number, up to 10 verified contacts, inbound-first, no dedicated number, no outbound messaging and no webhooks or callbacks; this is an iMessage/SMS/RCS messaging API test tier, not hosted compute capacity
free_tier.notes: The provider list's '$0.33/h' and '303 h free (one time)' entries do not appear on the first-party pricing page read on 2026-11-25. The page prices the production tier per phone line at $100/month, not per compute hour, and gives no CPU, RAM, VM, disk or runtime allowance. No hourly compute price is published.

egress.terms: not applicable as compute egress: the sandbox has no outbound messaging and no webhooks or callbacks; no network traffic allowance or price per GB is published

interface_detail: Full API access with CLI and SDK support in a rate-limited test environment; the API sends and receives iMessages, SMS and RCS from a shared phone number. There is no shell, VM, container or code-execution interface.
tooling: REST API, CLI and SDKs for the iMessage/SMS/RCS messaging API. No compute sandbox CLI, SSH, VM console or code-execution client is published on the pages read.
chaining: A free messaging-API test tier can validate an inbound-first iMessage integration behind a shared number, but it supplies no computable machine, so it cannot be chained into a compute workload; a hosted sandbox service is needed for that.

limits.value: up to 10 verified contacts on a shared phone number; no outbound messaging and no webhooks or callbacks

limits_note: Inbound-first: contacts text the number first. The production AI Agent plan is $100/month per dedicated line with 1,000 inbound contacts/day; the sandbox has no dedicated number.
binding_note: The sandbox's 10-verified-contact ceiling binds before anything else, and it is a messaging-contact limit rather than a compute quota.
